EC1: Patient has been permanently [NOT] discontinued from nilotinib  treatment in the parent study [AND] due to unacceptable toxicity [OR], non-compliance to study procedures [OR], [NOT] withdrawal of consent [OR] or any other reason
EC2: Patient has participated in a Novartis sponsored combination trial where nilotinib was dispensed in combination with another study medication and patient is still receiving combination therapy
EC3: Patients who are currently receiving treatment [AND] with any medications that have the potential to prolong the QT interval [OR] or inducing Torsade de Pointes and the treatment cannot be either safely discontinued at least one week prior to nilotinib treatment or switched to a different medication prior to start of nilotinib treatment and for the duration of the study
EC4: Pregnant [OR] or nursing (lactating) women, where pregnancy is defined as the state of a female after conception and until the termination of gestation, confirmed by a positive hcG laboratory test.
EC5: Women of child-bearing potential, defined as all women physiologically capable of becoming pregnant, [NOT] unless they are using highly effective methods of contraception during the study and for 30 days after the final dose of nilotinib.
